resources.string: Recognize Chinese seal-script characters from seals, rubbings and inscriptions.

Cropping happens on your device. Only crops you submit are uploaded for recognition.
Each crop must contain one complete character. Edit or delete incorrect crops before recognition.
Recognize up to 10 crops per batch. Delete extra crops or recognize them individually.
Scores measure similarity, not certainty. Compare the reference glyphs before using a result.

Selected crops will be sent to cyeam.com for cloud recognition. The service may retain submitted crops, results and your IP for OCR debugging. Avoid images containing private information.

Google Analytics records usage events and counts. Images and recognized text are never included in analytics events. You can disable collection here.

Cropping is performed locally. Submitted character crops are sent to cyeam.com and its OCR provider; the service may retain crops, results and IP for debugging. The last 50 candidate lists are stored on this device and can be cleared from History. Firebase Analytics collects app usage when enabled; switch it off in Settings. No account is required.
Updates are checked at startup and downloaded on unmetered networks. Android will ask you to confirm installation.
